notes: Upgrades the m=3 bound of arXiv:2605.28586 from reproduced to verified (exact: true). Unnormalised |N> = (-1, 2, 2) lies in Z^3, and all 30,240 three-qutrit stabilizer states lie in Z[omega_3]^27. Scanning the 74 symmetry pivot orbit representatives of |N>^3 in exact Z[omega_3] arithmetic via projective ray canonicalisation (multiplying by bar(z) = (a - b) - b*omega_3 and dividing by the row GCD) shows that every collinear bucket in the second quotient Q(omega_3)^27 / span(|N>^3, s_piv) is already collinear modulo s_piv alone in Z[omega_3]^27 (dependent stabilizer triples in a 2D stabilizer subspace), with zero floating-point margins. Together with the Lean rank-4 witness this settles chi(|N>^3) = 4 at the verified/lean tier in both directions.
